summary.text: Roger Lynch is a Republican member of the Arkansas House of Representatives for District 60, which covers parts of Lonoke, Prairie and Pulaski counties.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Lynch's first House term as 2017, ten years on the Lonoke County Quorum Court, and self-employment in heating and air conditioning.

sources.title: Representative Roger D. Lynch (R) - Arkansas State Legislature
